releases.notes:
This update adds more cuirass options for travelers, makes various tweaks and fixes to content from the slimesuit update, and adds a ton of new and improved JEI integration. Assuming no major issues are discovered, this update will be marked as the release for the slimesuit update.

## Tools

* Repair kit "stats" no longer show in the part builder stat listing. Its just an internal type to force the repair kit item to show.
* Fix iron armor showing an untranslated internal "iron armor" modifier.
* Fix modifier crystal tooltips having inconsistent colors.
  * The color was not added intentionally originally, was just missed as the test for that feature happened to have a white name.
  * After seeing it, feature looks neat so the full name is colored now.
* Reduce protection from dragonborn from 10% to 8%.
* Reduce overslime granted from ichor, as its way easier to get now.
* Sort stats in the part builder alphabetically by ID, so the order is consistent between different materials.
* Reduce speed granted from twisting vine laces from 15% to 10%.
* Buff feather weight armor (aluminum), giving it a movement speed boost and less protection penalty.
* Fix other mods letting you glide from non-chestplate sources damaging our chestplates (#5726).
* Fix some modifiers missing from blacklists, making them show up in recipes they shouldn't.
* Fix tool materials tooltip not showing names of "illegal" tool parts, as we use those for legacy and display.
* Fix material duplication when material swapping daggers using another dagger.
* Fixed unburdened on shield cores not matching the value shown in the encyclopedia.

### Travelers Cuirass

* Cuirass on travelers now includes vines and wool instead of just leather variants.
* You can craft travelers in the crafting table using vine in place of leather in the recipe (making it available earlier game!)
* Combining travelers in the anvil with the right materials will let you swap it.
* Leather composites still require leather as a base material. You can always swap the vine for leather before casting.
* New material options:
  * Wool: grants knockback resistance.
  * Vine: grants solar powered, making it lose less durability in sunlight.
  * Weeping Vine: grants flamestance, granting protection in warm biomes.
  * Twisting Vine: grants entwined, boosting movement speed at the cost of damaging you when it is removed.
  * Slimy vines are discussed below.
* Vines were removed as cuirass options to help make travelers more unique. Most of their traits were non-defensive anyways.
* Travelers shield also supports the new cuirass. Its wood part swapping now just uses planks in an anvil.

### Slimeskin and Slimy Vines

* Sky/Ender Slimeskin and Sky/Ender Slimy Vines were split from each other, providing different traits.
* As maille no longer gets vines, this means the slimeskins are meant as defensive while the vines are more utility.
* Sky Slimy Vine was given skyfall, which is now travelers exclusive.
* Ender Slimy Vine grants enderdodging, which was previously slimesuit exclusive. Its still end exclusive so balancewise seems fine.
* Sky Slimeskin grants Airborn, reducing damage from attackers in the air. Counts dragonborn, critical hits, and flying enemies.
* Ender Slimeskin grants enderclearance, teleporting away attackers. Was the previous trait on enderslime vines.

### Slimesuit

* Added venom as a new slime material, grants magic resistance. Can be repaired with spider eyes or by casting venom repair kits.
* Ender pearl was changed to enderclearance, better fitting how hard it is to get by comparison.
* Buff leather laces. Instead of snow boots, they now grant rugged. In addition to walking on powder snow, it makes you immune to various hazardous blocks like cactus. When trimmed, it also makes you immune to thorns.
* Enderdodging is now slightly weaker on level 1, restoring the previous power at level 2. This keeps slimesuit ahead of travelers since travelers gets just 1 level.

releases.notes:
The slimesuit update makes several huge improvements to slimesuits, adds many features from the roadmap including Knightslime, and makes many internal changes to prepare for the 1.21 port.

## Tools

* Improve performance of dropping indestructible tools.
* Allow any damage type that bypasses invulnerability to kill indestructible tools.
* Allow dyeing plate armor, which changes the color of the maille.
* Allow dyeing slimesuit, which changes the color of the mob parts.
* On tools with 2 heads that have distinct durability values, repair now uses the largest instead of the first.
* Remove the nose guard on slimeskull helmets, so we can see more of the skull.
* If a tool is destroyed in world (e.g. by cactus or lava), it will now drop all contained items. For example, a bow with quiver will drop all its arrows when destroyed, or a slimeshell will drop its contained items.
* Make daggers effective at mining glass blocks. They needed a tool and daggers seemed like a good fit.
* Fix missing material textures for cast fishing rod reel (#5591).
* Fix thrown tools not updating their appearance when something changes on hit (#5584).
* Fix longbows not rendering the broken override when firing broken tools.
* Fix tools storing inventory out of order, causing some inconsistencies with modifiers such as bulk quiver.
* Fix swapped recycling recipes on earth and sky staffs (#5634).
* Fix modifiable armor with 0 armor points showing a blank "When on ..." attributes section.
* Fix waterlogged tables not updating properly (thanks @KacperTheDev, PR #5697, issue #5689).
* Fix fake players causing unpredictable AOE mining (#5713).
* Fix slimeskull armor model moving oddly from sneaking, moving the head, or being worn on mobs.
* Fix fishing rods from `/give` not having their hook material set.
* Fix circle attacks (e.g. scythes) hitting too many mobs (thanks @utafrali, PR #5663, issue #5662)

### Slimesuit

* Allow swapping skulls by crafting a skull item with the tool.
  * This notably conflicts with the recipe for recapitated/draconic, so applying recapitated/draconic on a slimeskull now requires an extra slimeball.
  * As part of skull updates, some skulls may have changed "materials". So you may need to swap to return to the desired type.
* Piglin slimeskull now wiggle the ears as you walk.

#### More Slime

* Slimesuit now supports using any slime instead of just enderslime.
  * The recipe was changed to cost 1/4 of the slime as before, so 5/8/7/4 slimeballs for casting helmets/chestplate/legging/boots.
* Additionally, all slimesuit pieces except slimelytra now start with 2 ability slots instead of 1.
  * To compensate, slimesuit now has 2 less upgrade slots than it did before.
* Slimes each have unique traits and different durability and overslime amounts. Additionally, the slime type acts as a repair material.
  * Earthslime grants Overgrowth, restoring overslime over time.
  * Skyslime grants Skyfall, reducing the effect of gravity.
  * Ichor grants Godspeed, boosting your movement, attack, and mining speed.
  * Enderslime grants Enderdodging, giving you a chance to entirely avoid attacks.
  * Magma grants Fire Protection, reducing incoming fire damage and fire duration.
  * Ender Pearls grant Magic Protection, reducing incoming magic damage and negative effect duration.
  * Clay grants Self-Forming, boosting your armor.
  * Honey grants Scrumptious, allowing you to eat your armor after taking damage.
* Any slimesuits crafted before this update will be automatically migrated to Blood, which restores modifier slots to those before this update.
  * You can swap the slime type on existing slimesuit pieces by casting the new desired slime onto it.
  * Keep in mind your armor may need have some modifiers removed first to swap, since removing blood will cause it to lose 2 upgrade slots.

#### New Slimeskulls

* Added dragon slimeskull:
  * Crafted from enderslime on a dragon head.

releases.notes:
Bug fix updates.

## Tools

* Tweak how sling modifiers handle knockback. Now knockback attributes and padded only scale the bonus from knockback itself. Produces a more reasonable upper bound and penalizes players wearing knockback resistance less.
* Limit max level of spitting to 3, as spitting's bypassing iframes lead to some insane damage when uncapped.
* Restore former max level to boundless. Dual wielding still lets you reach it.
* Improve block animations for shields in third person.
* Improve throwing animations for javelins and swords in third person.
* Fix a few cases of non-ranged tools getting ranged stat bonuses.
* Fix melting pans not showing the charge + block animation.
* Fix explosive fluids (e.g. queens slime) not stacking their damage with melee or ranged attacks.
* Fix shurikens with smashing not stacking damage with fluid damage.
* Fix fluid cannons being unable to use scythe harvest AOE.
* Fully deprecate piercing and sticky modifiers, both have been removed for awhile.

## Smeltery

* Fix faucets, channels and alike being broken by flowing fluids.

## World

* Fix terracubes spawning in mushroom islands and the deep dark (#5574)

## Documentation

* Added new informational pages to mighty smelting:
  * Interacting with tool tanks
  * Basic tips for tools and abilities
  * "The Thruul Method" of tool design
* Add melting pan info to the encyclopedia.
* Add page on cobalt ore to tinkers gadgetry.
* Fix missing beacon base tooltips.
* Fix perfect aim being granted on any bow or 100% accuracy arrows.
* Fix reference to unarmed modifier in encyclopedia (all chestplates have unarmed attacking now).
* Fix a few more typos.

### Translations

* Chilean spanish localization by @imkingstar in https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/pull/5576
* Russian Translation Update (1.20.1) by @deaddiesel in https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/pull/5559

## Data packs

* Add variable support to sling force module. Currently just uses the conditional stat variable context, so it has access to holder but not target.
* Added modifier level tool variable, which lets you fetch a modifier level as a variable.

## New Contributors

* @imkingstar made their first contribution in https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/pull/5576
* @deaddiesel made their first contribution in https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/pull/5559

## Full Changelog

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/compare/v3.11.1.158...v3.11.2.165

releases.notes:
This update is primarily bug fixes and balance tweaks to the Throwback update, though it also provides a few smaller features.

## Tools

* Reduce fishing rod damage slightly (multiplier reduced from 2 to 1.5) as it was a bit too close to bow damage.
* Give staffs all 1 level of reach, to set them apart from barebows.
* Arrows now support the velocity stat from traits, multiplying by the bow velocity.
* Fix barebow still firing arrows in creative on longbows.
* Fix tools with too much NBT being unable to open their UI. This does make it less resilient to laggy servers, so we provided a config option for the older behavior.

### Modifiers

* Relax restrictions on enderporting teleporting - the multishot fix accidently broke some desired functions including teleporting using crystalshot
* Adjust priorities to ensure that bounce runs before explosive on arrows (gunpowder + slimewood will bounce three times then explode).
* Allow shields and battle signs to receive offhanded and nohanded.
* Allow collecting to pull "creative only" arrows out of the sky, such as from skeletons (#5562).
* Grapple now requires slimesteel instead of cinderslime.
* Smelting modifier now uses the `ProjectileWithPower` interface for smelting time from projectiles.
* Flip side hit for exchanging for better slab placement.
* Reduced extra projectiles at higher levels of spitting from +2 per level to +1 per level, on account of them being so good by ignoring iframes.
* Fix possible dupe and deletion bug when killing yourself with a ballista or thrown tool.
* Fix incremental modifier recipe not running the validation hook.
* Fix projectile hit merger not calling the newest version of the hook.
* Fix conditional stat module not using multiplier in tooltips (affects dragonborn notably, see #5565)
* Fix bonking syncing motion for the wrong entity.

#### Blockade

* New modifier for anything that supports blocking or parrying.
* Grants +100% block amount per level.
* Costs obsidian panes to apply, plus 1 upgrade slot.

#### Blunted

* Slotless modifier which disables melee attacks on tools such as staffs or fishing rods.
* Useful to allow using left click modifiers when close to a mob.

#### Smelting Revamp

* Smelting modifier now includes input and output slots.
* The input slot now supports up to stack size 64.
* The output slot only supports removing items, and will receive smelted items like a furnace.
* At higher levels, all slots smelt instead of just the first slot.
* Max level is now 4.

#### Sling Modifiers

* Now have new modifier hooks allowing other modifiers to respond.
* Allows traits such as momentum, insatiable, and valiant to apply if their conditions are matched. Similarly, restrictions from traits such as crystalbound now work.
* Fix flinging and slinging not properly responding to knockback resistance (as it doesn't sync by default). There is a config option in case the syncing breaks something.
* Fix sling modifiers with too little force still triggering.

### Materials

* Tweak ductile (steel) stats:
  * Now grants 5% melee damage instead of 8% (since it also grants durability).
  * Now grants +0.25 power instead of +5% power (stronger when power is less than 5).
  * Handle stats now properly boost melee damage instead of melee speed (got swapped accidently from the design doc).
* Cactus now works as a bowlimb and arrow shaft material. It grants +10% velocity at the cost of damaging you when an arrow is fired.
* Reduce extra drop chance from autosmelt+ (fiery) from 25% to 20%, to better match up with melting pan multipliers.
* Featherweight (aluminum), lightweight (cobalt), and heavy (lead) now all add their ranged stats instead of multiplying, to better match the book descriptions. This will be slightly stronger on tools with low stats, but slightly weaker on tools with high stats.
* Lightweight (cobalt) now grants 8% mining speed and attack speed instead of 7%.
* Buffed momentum (hepatizon) similarly to the recent insatiable buff:

releases.notes:
Will likely be the last release for 1.19.2 unless major bugs are discovered. Development is moved onto focus on 1.20 now.

## Ancient Tools

* New tool variant which must be found in loot instead of being crafted.
* Designed as a strong tool variant with a little less freedom of design. In addition, each ancient tool has very unique functions.
* Materials on the tool are randomized, and part swapping is not supported. However, modifiers may still be applied.
* Ancient tools get more slots from rebalanced.
* All ancient tools can be bought from wandering traders.
* Currently 3 ancient tools are in the mod.

### Melting Pan

* The melting pan is a cross between a mining tool and a staff.
* Can mine any meltable blocks, but melts the result into fluid which is placed in its internal tank.
* Can only hold one fluid type, meaning blocks that melt into a different fluid cannot be mined.
* Has two materials - a shield plating (armor) and a limb (ranged).
* Found in dungeons, igloos, and sometimes in the hands of husks.
* Can also be obtained from a toolsmith villager as a hero of the village reward.

### War Pick

* Cross between a pickaxe and a crossbow.
* Has three materials - a tool head (melee/harvest), a limb (ranged), and a bowstring (ranged).
* Found in mineshafts, pillager outposts, woodland mansions, and sometimes in the hands of zombie villagers.
* Can also be obtained from a weaponsmith villager as a hero of the village reward.

### Battlesign

* Cross between a sword and a shield.
* Has two materials - a tool head (melee/harvest) and a shield plating (armor).
* Found in bastions, and sometimes in the hands of piglins.
* Can also be obtained from bartering.

## Tools

* Parts tooltip list now shows the stat type name next to the material name for materials that don't have a part.
* Zoom and bonking now both support blocking while using.
* Shields can now receive flinging, springing, bonking, warping, spitting, and zoom.
* Fix animated sprite transformer not being registered, prevented using the generate part textures command to make blazewood properly.
* Fix some tools not registering item colors properly, which potentially affects modifier models]
* Fixed color in fixed texture data provider not being datagenned.
* Fix broken crossbow string textures not being generated.

## Modifiers

* Deprecated modifier salvage having nullable slots, all salvage does is apply modifier slots.
* Disabled cheating in modifier crystals from JEI if the crystal is unextractable (aka it is not usable in recipes).
* Quick charge is now crafted from sunflowers instead of redstone.
* Fix some severing recipe variants not syncing to client properly.
* Fix freezing fluid effect consuming wrong amount of fluid when a mob is already frozen.
* Fix mob effect fluid effects possibly increasing the duration of a high level mob effect.
* Fix harvest modifier not using the tools enchantments on harvest.
* Fix modifier sorting recipe letting you "sort" with just 1 modifier.

### Smelting

* New modifier for any interactable tools and any worn armor.
* Costs 1 upgrade slot and 1 campfire per level.
* Adds 2 slot per level for cooking items.
* When using the tool (attacking mobs, mining blocks, etc.), slowly cooks the items inside using furnace recipes.

## Smeltery

* Compatibility alloy materials now are available if either a mod adds the relevant ingot, or a mod adds the relevant ingot for all components.
    * For example, bronze is available if either a mod adds tin or a mod adds bronze.
* Molding recipes now properly ignore count on the output, since the table cannot store stack sizes above 1.
* Remove broken recipes for golden bricks from Ceramics, they just cost too little gold.
* Fix molting recipe lookup running twice when the player's hand is empty.

releases.notes:
This will most likely be the last release for 1.18.2 barring any significant bugs discovered. It contains a ton of bug fixes and minor features backported from the 1.19.2 branch.

### Tools

* Sand casts can now be created in the part builder
* Fix extra ingredients in tool recipes being ignored in the tinker station under some circumstances
* Fix part builder not always updating the material value when materials change

### Modifiers

* Modifier crystal and modifiers in JEI both now show the modifier description.
* Strong bones and boon of sssss will no longer function if cheated onto a non-helmet. before they partly functioned but some features required helmets.
* Make magnetic run after firing a bow.
* Made revitalizing cheaper, and removed the max level.
* Mob disguise (slimeskull traits) are now a bit stronger and support multiple levels (not that we use it currently, 1.19.2 does)
* Fix magnetic modifier running when tools are held.
* Fix conditional mining speed module not checking the holder condition (affects airborne trait)
* Fix incremental modifier recipes having backwards leftover calculation.
* Fix tank module serializer having the wrong default keys
* Fix feather falling not being marked as an incremental modifier
* Fix a couple of modifier recipes that require durability being available to tools that lack durability.
* Fix temperate not working properly on bows

### Smeltery

* Part casts now show the material cost in the tooltip.
* Fix a couple of compat recipes for Ceramics containing invalid byproducts.
* Fix being able to cast water on oxidized copper to make oxidized copper
* Fix spectators being able to change the order of smeltery fluids

### Misc

* Modifier variant names (e.g. rebalanced or embellishment) now show in JEI recipe.
* Added a new recipe category for tool recipes (thanks paypur!)
* Blacklisted various crafting blocks as valid "side inventories" for the crafting station and part builder. This works around an issue with output slots and in most cases this is not the desired block for the connection.
* Fix platform blocks defaulting waterlogged to true (affects setblock)
* Fix slimy leaves suffocating players.
* Fix mud brick slabs and stairs having no proper tool.
* Fix wrong blocking model on broad axes
* Fix potential crash if a modifier model exists on large but not small or vice versa

### Books & Language

* Merged the melee/harvest material sections into a single section. Also merge the ranged material sections into a single section. This keeps the index to a much more manageable size.
* Encyclopedia pages no longer require advancements to unlock. The above change meant too few sections still used this feature, and ultimately there was not much gained by it.
* Material pages no longer list composites from the material to itself (e.g. oxidized copper from copper)
* Many typos fixed, too many to list
* Fix tool pages in materials and you loading from the wrong folder
* Fix book index links not working for sections with modifiers in multiple groups
* Fix tooltip overlap on material pages

### Translation

* Update zh_tw localization (thanks StarlightCraft!)
* Update Japanese translation (thanks koh-gh!)
* Update Turkish Translation (thanks imsi32!)
* Update Chinese Translation (thanks Cactusstudent and ChuijkYahus!)

### Technical & API

* Add default value to `ModifierPredicate`
* Added `ModifierHookProvider`, interface to create modules that don't serialize to JSON. It just adds default hooks so you don't have to manually specify them in the module map builder.
* Added `BasicModifier`, extraction of the base class for `ComposableModifier` which includes a builder for registering a modifier with modules statically.
* Added modifier priority command, to list all modifiers, the hooks they implement, and their priority value. Useful for ensuring hooks run in the right order.

releases.notes:
This will most likely be the last 1.16.5 build unless significant issues arise. Development will be focused on 1.18.2

### Tools

* Update slimeskull durability to make repairing less expensive
* Fix custom armor not always showing the enchantment glint
* Fix plate armor being repaired with manyullyn instead of cobalt

### Materials

* Added config to disable dragon scale drops
* Added darkthread, a binding only composite of obsidian and string that grants a tool looting
* Added ancient hide, a binding only composite of ancient debris and leather that grant a tool fortune
* Tweak textures of nahuatl by using wood as a base
* Tweak textures of several materials that only exist as repair kits
* Fix invariant being backwards
* Fix random material deserializer crashing (used for tools in loot tables)
* Fix bone items having wrong orientation in hand
* Fix some compat material recipes not disabling properly when the material is not present

### Modifiers

* Added protection modifier, a new ability providing general protection. Together with the defense slot modifiers, armor can now reach levels of protection comparable to netherite armor
* Added clay and honey as embellishments for slimesuit
* Added obsidian and debris as embellishments for plate armor
* Move tinkers keybindings to their own category
* Diamond now only boosts armor durability by 250 instead of 500 to be more inline with vanilla diamond armor
* Improve tooltips on several modifiers, notably adding a tooltip to temperate
* Fix extra hand when holding map with some armor modifiers

### Modifier recipes

* Netherite embellishment now costs nuggets instead of ingots
* Exchanging and autosmelt can now be added to all harvest tools instead of just "primary" harvest tools
* Players now have a higher drop rate of heads from severing, making it possible to get 100% drop rate with the right modifiers
* Interaction modifiers such as tilling and pathing now use cobalt instead of netherite scrap in the recipe
* Allow creating seared reinforcement using scorched stone, for nether runs
* Looting on chestplates is now an upgrade, and now properly requires unarmed to make it more clear it only affects unarmed attacks
* Make autosmelt recipe a bit cheaper, making it possible with overworld resources
* Fix toolbelt having a max of level 1

### Smeltery

* Discourage mobs from pathfinding into an active smeltery or foundry
* Cast chest can now be crafted using any cast type. This is more consistent with the recipe in 1.18, where blank casts no longer exist
* Add recipes for casting magma using blazing blood and slime

### World

* Fix skyslime grass on ender dirt having the wrong texture
* Fix trapdoor textures orienting wrongly when opened

### Books

* Improve page for repair kits
* Fix some typos in books

### Data

* Added timers to data loaders to keep track of how fast they load
* Make model caches concurrent, I am told some performance mod causes a crash if they are not concurrent, and its a trivial fix
* Make modifier recipes support stackable tinker tools. We don't use this feature internally, but an addon requested it
* Tool stat JSON have better merging logic across multiple datapacks. Now instead of needing to provide all stats, you only need to provide the ones you change. For example, you can change the harvest level of a material without being forced to override its durability, attack damage, and mining speed
* Make texture scanners less likely to fail if the order of resource loading changes
